description: Returns the primary-sourced contractual & fine-print dossier for a telehealth brand: billing cycle (28 vs 30 days), whether price rises with higher doses, prepay requirements, cancellation window & accepted channel, refund policy if clinician denies, return fees, card statement descriptor, HSA/FSA status, pharmacy choice waiver, arbitration clause, internal T&C contradictions, and deterministic Transparency Score (0-100). Every verified fact carries its primary URL, T&C section (§), short literal quote, and verification date; null means not published or not yet audited. Use when a user asks about cancellation, refunds, hidden traps, bank statement name, or T&C terms (e.g. "Can I cancel Direct Meds?", "Does Found bill every 28 days?", "What shows up on my credit card?"). Example arguments: {"id":"direct-meds"}.

id.description: Required. Company slug or any program id (e.g. "direct-meds", "direct-meds-es", "found-health", "embody-sermorelin"). Resolved automatically to the parent company record.
